claims.quote: Type locality: Rio Caldeirão, Rio Paraguaçu basin, Município de Lençóis, Estado da Bahia, Brazil, 12°39'33"S, 41°22'13"W, elevation about 340 metres.
Found in a single locality, the Rio Caldeirão, a tributary of the Rio São José, which is among the main tributaries of the upper Rio Paraguaçu River, Brazilian semiarid Caatinga, Bahia State.
